import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'Person ID': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    'Gender': ['Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male'],
    'Age': [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    'Occupation': ['Software Engineer', 'Doctor', 'Doctor', 'Sales Representative', 'Sales Representative'],
    'Sleep Duration': [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    'Quality of Sleep': [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    'Physical Activity Level': [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],
    'Stress Level': [6, 8, 8, 8, 8],
    'BMI Category': ['Overweight', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Obese', 'Obese'],
    'Blood Pressure': ['126/83', '125/80', '125/80', '140/90', '140/90'],
    'Heart Rate': [77, 75, 75, 85, 85],
    'Daily Steps': [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    'Sleep Disorder': ['', '', '', 'Sleep Apnea', 'Sleep Apnea']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Parse blood pressure into systolic and diastolic
df[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = [15, 10]
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 10

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(constrained_layout=True)

# Create grid specification
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3)

# Plot 1: Sleep metrics by occupation
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
sleep_metrics = df.groupby('Occupation')[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep']].mean()
sleep_metrics.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['skyblue', 'lightcoral'])
ax1.set_title('Sleep Metrics by Occupation')
ax1.set_ylabel('Score/Hours')
ax1.set_xlabel('')
ax1.legend(['Sleep Duration (hrs)', 'Sleep Quality (1-10)'])
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Plot 2: Physical activity vs daily steps
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Daily Steps'], 
                     c=df['Stress Level'], s=100, cmap='RdYlGn_r', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Daily Steps')
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps (colored by Stress Level)')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2, label='Stress Level')

# Plot 3: BMI distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors = ['lightgreen', 'gold', 'salmon']
ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution')

# Plot 4: Health metrics correlation heatmap
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :])
health_metrics = df[['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 
                     'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 
                     'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps', 'Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']]
corr_matrix = health_metrics.corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=1, ax=ax4, cbar_kws={'label': 'Correlation'})
ax4.set_title('Health Metrics Correlation Matrix')

# Plot 5: Blood pressure by BMI category
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
bp_data = df.groupby('BMI Category')[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']].mean()
bp_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax5, color=['firebrick', 'darkred'])
ax5.set_title('Blood Pressure by BMI Category')
ax5.set_ylabel('Blood Pressure (mmHg)')
ax5.set_xlabel('')
ax5.legend(['Systolic', 'Diastolic'])
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Plot 6: Heart rate distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Heart Rate', ax=ax6, palette='Set2')
sns.stripplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Heart Rate', ax=ax6, 
              color='black', size=8, jitter=True)
ax6.set_title('Heart Rate by BMI Category')
ax6.set_xlabel('')
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')

# Plot 7: Sleep disorder presence
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
sleep_disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].replace('', 'None').value_counts()
bars = ax7.bar(sleep_disorder_counts.index, sleep_disorder_counts.values, 
               color=['lightgray', 'steelblue'])
ax7.set_title('Sleep Disorder Presence')
ax7.set_ylabel('Count')
ax7.set_xlabel('')
for bar, count in zip(bars, sleep_disorder_counts.values):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax7.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.1,
             f'{count}', ha='center', va='bottom')

# Add overall title
plt.suptitle('Health and Sleep Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
